findings.title: Surviving mutant MB: news provenance links any AI request when it is the first one opened
findings.command: perl -0pi -e 's/if r\.purpose == "news" then/if true then/' sim/core.ail && make sim  # exit 0, 179/179
findings.fix: In checkRecordOtherRequest (or a new test) open the crew-line request BEFORE the news request ([lineOpen(), newsOpen()]) and assert the news item's aiRequestId is the news request's id, and that accepting/refusing the line leaves body_source template. Needed before M4.4/AC6 rely on body_source.

findings.title: Surviving mutant MA: the legacy log delta ('appended since from') is untested
findings.command: perl -0pi -e 's/arr\(each\(entryObj, dropN\(v\.cq\.log, from\)\)\)/arr(each(entryObj, v.cq.log))/' sim/protocol.ail && make sim  # exit 0
findings.fix: Add a wire test over two ticks that each append entries (e.g. commit, then the boost crossing): the second reply's legacy.appended holds only the new entries and legacy.count is the running total; a tick that appends nothing omits the consequence section or has appended [].

findings.title: Surviving mutant MC: the displayed `progress` field has no test
findings.command: perl -0pi -e 's/if f < 0\.0 then 0\.0 else if f > 1\.0 then 1\.0 else f/0.0/' sim/core.ail && make sim  # exit 0
findings.fix: Assert progress = 0 docked/planned, strictly increasing through boost/cruise/brake, ~0.5 near mid-cruise (by distance), exactly 1 at arrival, and clamped to [0,1] (M4.3a's HUD binds it).

findings.title: D-14 stand-off is opt-in from the client and not echoed in params
findings.command: grep -n standoffAu sim/core.ail sim/protocol.ail; design m4-first-journey.md:308-312 ('M4.1 owns the stand-off')
findings.fix: Either (a) default standoff_au to 1000 for sessions negotiated at minor >= 2 (keeping 0 below minor 2 so M2 streams stay byte-identical), or (b) add an explicit M4.3a acceptance criterion that the Godot client sends standoff_au: 1000 and that consequence.standoff_ly = 0.0158125 is asserted on the wire. Also consider echoing standoff_au in the params section for minor-2 sessions only.

findings.title: ship.ism is spliced into encodeShip's output by string surgery
findings.fix: Build the ship object from its field list (pass an extra field list into encodeShip) instead of dropping the last character of an already-encoded string.
